clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, within a year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents growing distant by November, shouting matches between your father and brother Jonah by May 1996, you developing stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, and your mother's functioning dropping when she did not return to her job by September 1996. The shifts pile up across the household in these months, and your mother's withdrawal from work marks where the period settles.
